propositions: sign_manifest treats transient store-read-failure from pre-lock reads as terminal and immediately raises PlanReviewGenerationError, while the sibling moving-HEAD transient is retried within MAX_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS

A peer session staging tracked entries via git add->commit on the shared .git/index causes git status/git ls-files to observe a non-empty index, triggering store-read-failure in tracker_head_sha even with ignore_untracked=True
Transient store-read-failure during plan-review signing must be retried within the generation loop and surface as PlanReviewGenerationRetryable only after exhaustion, not as terminal error
Fix changes the except PlanRelationSnapshotError handler to retry store-read-failure via continue (mirroring the moving-HEAD path) while keeping deterministic snapshot errors terminal
The authoritative under-lock re-check (under_lock_check) remains the fence because no writer can stage concurrently while the store write lock is held
